metadata.method: Serial predict including tokenization, copies, inference and formatting. No HTTP. First use and model load excluded. Exclusive GPU/build lock.
metadata.validation_scope: Synthetic implementation parity, not labeled model quality.

token_tables.scope: Frozen token embeddings and first QKV, before positional mixing

attention_special.scope: Local attention, batch=1, length=64, window>=63; real bias retained for padding when enabled

global_attention.scope: Encoder attention only, shape=(1,16,64,64); unmasked Flash and optional broadcast-mask CUTLASS, all other shapes retain their prior path
